subject.title: feat: publish integrations and Crabbox Agent Skill discovery

question: Should Crabbox maintain cross-vendor client compatibility claims plus draft Agent Skills/AI Catalog domain-discovery artifacts in core, or limit this work to the existing repo-local skill and documented CLI initialization behavior?
rationale: The PR creates a broad, externally visible compatibility commitment across draft protocols and many independently evolving clients; code review cannot establish whether that ongoing maintenance contract is intended.

options.title: Narrow to supported core discovery
options.body: Keep the standard skill and repeatable initialization improvements, but defer draft domain catalogs and broad client-support claims until maintainers define a maintained publication contract.

options.title: Sponsor the publication contract
options.body: Accept the broader discovery surface and assign ownership for periodically validating the protocol drafts, client matrix, and published manifests.

recommendation.title: Narrow to supported core discovery
recommendation.body: Keep the standard skill and repeatable initialization improvements, but defer draft domain catalogs and broad client-support claims until maintainers define a maintained publication contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available adjacent contributor for the existing Zed and integration documentation surface, though the final product decision remains a maintainer choice.
